newsitem.title: USA: Across Media Networks wins advertising contract.
newsitem.headline: Across Media Networks wins advertising contract.

text.p: Privately held Across Media Networks said on Wednesday that it had received a contract to create ads for a division of TCI Media Services, the advertising arm for Tele-Communications Inc.

The outsourcing of the $2 million annual photo advertising business was awarded by Chicago Cable Advertising, Across Media said in a statement. Across Media said the move allowed Chicago Cable to focus on its core business of selling advertising.
The deal also increases the number of homes reached by Across Media by 40 percent, the company said.
